manual_comparable_pair_search: Selected original Removed-before-removal test has same pair removal/query and toContain assertion as official; only createRemoved lifetime differs (after initial pair state versus before). Original empty pre-query is retained to reset initial add observation window.

Other Removed/exclusive/destruction tests instantiate factories after existing pair state; moving before spawn without a pre-query would instead put add/remove in one window and contradict cancellation. Those incomplete hypotheses rejected.

AND tests combine pair with Foo/static trait or Added(pair,Foo), not Added(sameRelation); changing query parameters is stimulus repair. Non-first pair test only checks pair include, not trait exclude.
